names.1-candidate-absent: truth candidate is absent from the candidate set
names.2-ranking-wrong-nonstrong: truth is present, top-1 ranking is wrong, and verdict is not strong
names.3-correct-top-confidence-too-weak: top-1 is correct but confidence remains weak after the selected policy
names.4-wrong-top-strong: top-1 is wrong and receives a strong verdict
names.5-independence-policy-too-broad: candidate/ranking are correct but the global group gate rejects the strictly independent metadata+structural pair
names.resolved: correct top-1 with a strong verdict
